Let \(N=2015\) and \(\zeta=e^{2\pi i/N}\). By the reflection,
\[
P=\prod_{k=0}^{1439}\left(\cos\left(\frac{2^{k+1}\pi}{N}\right)-\frac12\right)
=\prod_{k=1}^{1440}\left(\cos\left(\frac{2^k\pi}{N}\right)-\frac12\right).
\]
The order of \(2\) modulo \(N\) is \(\operatorname{lcm}(4,12,5)=60\), and \(1440=24\cdot 60\). Thus if
\[
H=\{2^0,2^1,\dots,2^{59}\}\pmod N,
\]
then
\[
P=\left(\prod_{m\in H}\left(\cos\frac{2\pi m}{N}-\frac12\right)\right)^{24}.
\]
For \(m\in H\),
\[
\cos\frac{2\pi m}{N}-\frac12
=\frac{\zeta^{2m}-\zeta^m+1}{2\zeta^m}
=\frac{1+\zeta^{3m}}{2\zeta^m(1+\zeta^m)}.
\]
Hence
\[
\prod_{m\in H}\left(\cos\frac{2\pi m}{N}-\frac12\right)
=
\frac{\prod_{m\in H}(1+\zeta^{3m})}
{2^{60}\prod_{m\in H}\zeta^m\prod_{m\in H}(1+\zeta^m)}.
\]
Since
\[
\sum_{m\in H}m\equiv \sum_{j=0}^{59}2^j\equiv 0\pmod N,
\]
we have \(\prod_{m\in H}\zeta^m=1\). Also \(m\mapsto 2m\) permutes \(H\), so
\[
\prod_{m\in H}(1+\zeta^m)=1.
\]
Similarly, since \(2H=H\), the map \(n\mapsto 2n\) permutes \(3H\), giving
\[
\prod_{m\in H}(1+\zeta^{3m})=\prod_{n\in 3H}(1+\zeta^n)=1.
\]
Therefore
\[
\prod_{m\in H}\left(\cos\frac{2\pi m}{N}-\frac12\right)=\frac1{2^{60}},
\]
and
\[
P=\left(\frac1{2^{60}}\right)^{24}=\frac1{2^{1440}}.
\]
Thus \(a=1440\), \(b=1\), and
\[
a+b=1441.
\]
\[
\boxed{1441}
\]
